record.name: Glass Lancet
record.description: A needle of skyglass, thrown hard.
record.battleDescription: %user lifts one finger. A lancet of glass leaves the wall and finds %target.

record.name: The Glass Remembers
record.description: Enrage: every surface of the hall answers at once.
record.battleDescription: Every pane in the hall turns toward you at once. The glass has remembered all of you.

record.name: Refraction
record.description: Refraction: lines of light from the walls; they shatter on her next turn.
record.battleDescription: "Three lines. Mind them." Light runs in from the walls.

record.name: Far Refraction
record.description: Refraction: lines of light from the walls; they shatter on her next turn.
record.battleDescription: "Three more." Light runs in from the far walls.

record.name: Facet
record.description: Below 60%: her Refraction is drawn with its mirror image (both line sets); they shatter on her next turn.
record.battleDescription: "Every line has a reflection." The lines are drawn again, mirrored across the hall.

record.name: Refraction Breaks
record.description: The marked lines shatter.
record.battleDescription: The lines of light shatter where they lie.

record.name: Far Refraction Breaks
record.description: The marked lines shatter.
record.battleDescription: The far lines shatter where they lie.

record.name: Facet Breaks
record.description: The marked lines shatter.
record.battleDescription: Both images shatter at once.

record.name: Lucid Refraction
record.description: Lucid: the lines shatter and are drawn again at once.
record.battleDescription: The lines shatter, and new ones are already drawn. "I can see it clearly now."

record.name: Lucid
record.description: With the Silence gone, Sayo hears herself again: her glass cuts deeper.
record.battleDescription: The hall is suddenly very loud. %user straightens. "I can hear myself again."

record.name: Your Likeness
record.description: Below 40%: she casts your impression from the glass for three rounds.
record.battleDescription: "Hold still. There. That is you." Your likeness steps out of the glass.

record.name: Your Own Strike
record.description: Your likeness strikes with your habits.
record.battleDescription: %user strikes exactly the way you would.

record.name: The Hush
record.description: The Hush: stilled pools seep up through the floor; standing in one drains you and nothing heals you.
record.battleDescription: Somewhere on the floor, sound stops. It does not come back.

record.name: The Hush, Unbridled
record.description: The Hush: stilled pools seep up through the floor; standing in one drains you and nothing heals you.
record.battleDescription: Nothing holds the quiet back now. It pours up out of the floor.

record.name: The Listening
record.description: The Listening: a feeler of the deep rises and listens for movement.
record.battleDescription: Something under the floor turns toward the sound of you.

record.name: The Listening, Unbridled
record.description: The Listening: a feeler of the deep rises and listens for movement.
record.battleDescription: It no longer waits to hear you. Another feeler rises.

record.name: Stillness
record.description: The deep listens around the Silence: next turn, everything within 3 is crushed and stunned.
record.battleDescription: The floor around the Silence goes still. Nothing there is moving, and soon nothing will.

record.name: Nothing Moves
record.description: Everything within 3 of the Silence is crushed and stunned.
record.battleDescription: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves. Nothing can.

record.name: Cradle
record.description: While a feeler lives, the Silence holds Sayo: 90% less damage taken, and the hold cannot be cleared.
record.battleDescription: The deep closes around %target. Blows slide off the glass.

record.name: Grasp
record.description: The feeler takes hold of whatever is nearest: rooted, and drained.
record.battleDescription: %user closes around %target without a sound.

record.name: Etching: Rime
record.description: She etches a pattern into the glass. It will remember.
record.battleDescription: %user traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over, then fades.

record.name: Recast: Rime
record.description: The glass remembers an etching and detonates it, unmarked. While she recasts, her guard is open (x3 damage taken).
record.battleDescription: The glass remembers the rime, and the north of the hall breaks.

record.name: Etching: Ember
record.description: She etches a pattern into the glass. It will remember.
record.battleDescription: %user traces the south of the hall into the glass. It glows like an ember, then fades.

record.name: Recast: Ember
record.description: The glass remembers an etching and detonates it, unmarked. While she recasts, her guard is open (x3 damage taken).
record.battleDescription: The glass remembers the ember, and the south of the hall breaks.

record.name: Etching: Seam
record.description: She etches a pattern into the glass. It will remember.
record.battleDescription: %user traces a seam down the west wall. It glows, then fades.

record.name: Recast: Seam
record.description: The glass remembers an etching and detonates it, unmarked. While she recasts, her guard is open (x3 damage taken).
record.battleDescription: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks.

record.name: Etching: Heart
record.description: She etches a pattern into the glass. It will remember.
record.battleDescription: %user traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once, then fades.

record.name: Recast: Heart
record.description: The glass remembers an etching and detonates it, unmarked. While she recasts, her guard is open (x3 damage taken).
record.battleDescription: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks.

record.name: Etching: Hail
record.description: She etches a pattern into the glass. It will remember.
record.battleDescription: %user taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. They glow, then fade.

record.name: Recast: Hail
record.description: The glass remembers an etching and detonates it, unmarked. While she recasts, her guard is open (x3 damage taken).
record.battleDescription: The glass remembers the hail, and every point breaks at once.

record.name: The Hush Rises
record.description: While she etches, the Silence seeps up through the floor: stilled pools that drain and block healing, more of them every cycle.
record.battleDescription: The floor stops making any sound in patches. The patches do not close.

record.name: The Glass Falls Quiet
record.description: The cycle ends; a Worn afterimage is raised in the lull.
record.battleDescription: %user lowers her hand. "Again." Something worn steps out of the glass.

record.name: Raise the Gate Porter
record.description: Raises one of the Worn: the Gate Porter.
record.battleDescription: The gate porter steps out of the glass, still holding a door that is not there.

record.name: Raise Sister Hana
record.description: Raises one of the Worn: Sister Hana.
record.battleDescription: Sister Hana steps out of the glass, hands already busy with someone else's wounds.

record.name: Raise Cadet Tomo
record.description: Raises one of the Worn: Cadet Tomo.
record.battleDescription: Cadet Tomo steps out of the glass, rope in hand, waiting for an order.

record.name: Doorward Sweep
record.description: The porter sweeps the threshold: damage and a shove.
record.battleDescription: "Gate's closed." %user sweeps the threshold clear.

record.name: Worn Mending
record.description: Sister Hana tends Sayo, as she tended everyone.
record.battleDescription: "Hold still, it's nearly done." %user tends to %target.

record.name: Cadet's Tether
record.description: Tomo throws a line and hauls: pulled 3 hexes.
record.battleDescription: "Line's secure!" %user hauls %target in.

record.name: The Quiet
record.description: She channels: you take more damage and heal less, stacking; while she channels it cannot be cleansed.
record.battleDescription: %user closes her eyes. The hall goes very quiet, and you go quiet with it.

record.name: Shatterfall
record.description: A fan of cracks runs out from her; it falls on her next turn.
record.battleDescription: Cracks fan out from %user's feet.

record.name: Shatterfall Gives Way
record.description: The fan falls.
record.battleDescription: The fan of cracks gives way, and the glass beneath it falls.

record.name: Every Name in the Glass
record.description: Every stilled name rises to the floor; only where the three refused stays dry.
record.battleDescription: "Do you hear them? Every one of them stayed." The names rise. Three places stay dry: where the three refused.

record.name: The Names Flood In
record.description: The flood of names.
record.battleDescription: Every name in the glass floods the hall.

record.name: No One Is Mended
record.description: For the whole of Every Name in the Glass, the Hush covers the floor: nothing mends.
record.battleDescription: "Nothing mends here. Nothing needs to." The quiet covers the whole floor.

record.name: The Held Breath
record.description: She breathes in. Next turn, everyone not standing where the three refused is drawn in and loses their breath.
record.battleDescription: %user breathes in. The air leaves the hall, except where the three refused.

record.name: Breathless Pull
record.description: The breath she took is spent: everyone off the dry tiles is drawn toward her and stunned.
record.battleDescription: %user breathes out, and everyone she can reach comes with it, breathless.

record.name: Hush Where They Refused
record.description: The Hush seeps into one of the three dry places.
record.battleDescription: The quiet finds one of the dry places where the three refused.

record.name: The Long Hush
record.description: Below 25%: she cannot fall for 6 rounds; the glass begins to fall.
record.battleDescription: "Not yet. You are almost a good impression." The ceiling begins to fall.

record.name: Glassfall: First Pane
record.description: The marked third of the hall is crushed; the next third is marked.
record.battleDescription: A third of the ceiling comes down, and the next pane cracks.

record.name: Glassfall: Second Pane
record.description: The marked third of the hall is crushed; the next third is marked.
record.battleDescription: Another third of the ceiling comes down, and the next pane cracks.

record.name: Glassfall: Last Pane
record.description: The marked third of the hall is crushed; the next third is marked.
record.battleDescription: The last third of the ceiling comes down, and the first pane cracks again.

record.name: Glassfall: Opening Pane
record.description: The marked third of the hall is crushed; the next third is marked.
record.battleDescription: The second third of the ceiling comes down first, and the last pane cracks.

record.name: Glassfall: Heart Recast
record.description: The marked third of the hall is crushed; the next third is marked.
record.battleDescription: The ceiling comes down, and the glass remembers the heart once more.

quest.name: The Mother of Echoes
quest.kind: Battle pyramid (solo), three battles, isolated; health / chakra / stamina carried between battles, no refills (battle pools are kept from one battle to the next).

entry.note: RUL-2026-11-02-100: one of each shard, consumed at the start. No 'An Invitation in Glass' item.

objectives.text:
The four shards fit together in your hands, and the seams vanish. They were never broken. They were an invitation.

Under Crownhold the Mother Glass is singing. A woman in a glasswright's apron stands before it with her back to you. "You came. Good. I was beginning to think I had measured you wrong."

objectives.title: Act I: The Glasswright and the Deep
objectives.failObjective: end (loss: nothing granted; the shards are spent)

objectives.text: The deep goes quiet, but the glass does not. Sayo wipes a line of light from her sleeve. "You read patterns well. Let us see how well you remember them."
Every pane in the hall turns toward you. The Silence has stopped holding back, and so has she. "Hold still. You will make for a good impression."

The Mother Glass cracks from the root to the crown. For the first time since the siege, Crownhold makes a sound.

You are not stilled.

questFlags.note: law 23: consecutiveObjectives true on create; law 16b hidden on create; exact objective field names come from the builder's guide templates (law 31), not from this summary.

buildOrder: 1. Jutsu that reference no AI (all moe-* except the five summon jutsu below), hidden:true (law 16b).
2. Summon-template AIs with their jutsu: moe-ai-feeler, moe-ai-likeness (+ live Stolen Form), moe-ai-worn-porter / -hana / -tomo.
3. Summon jutsu with the created template ids as aiId (law 17 literal ids): moe-listening, moe-listening-unbridled, moe-your-likeness, moe-raise-gate-porter / -sister-hana / -cadet-tomo.
4. Boss AIs (moe-ai-sayo, -silence, -sayo-stilling, -saint) with full jutsu lists and AI Heavy Armor; rules last, with literal ids; inArena false.
5. Art assets: upload, then unhide every battle animation (law 16c).
6. The quest, then a separate publish step (law 16b).

Law 18: these records are created fresh and equipped once, so no unequip/edit/re-equip is needed at build. Any later edit to an equipped moe-* jutsu is unequip -> edit -> re-equip. Never edit Stolen Form (34 live holders).
Two AIs share the display name 'Sayo, Mother of Echoes' (Acts I and II): create by srcId, and check name collisions against live records (law 30).

proofs.P1: Recast via use_combo_action, one rule per cycle (PASS; marker fallback characterised: a marker with rounds k counts in the cast turn and the next k turns). Every combo turn spends exactly 100 AP (wait enters usedActions). Interruptions restart the cycle, never detonate unmarked. Act II Sayo has innate stunprevent.
proofs.P2: Cradle cast by the feeler on HIGHEST_MAX_HEALTH_ALLY, gated on Sayo's token (PASS; clear-proof; 93 -> 22).
proofs.P3: healprevent stops heal, vamp and lifesteal/absorb created after it; NOT gear lifesteal present from round 0, siphon or shields (PARTIAL; fallback: damage carries Movement 2).
proofs.P4: Hush = RANDOM-seeded GROUND healprevent + drain pools, 8 rounds; drain's shared cooldown = every third turn (PASS).
proofs.P5: Partner death via target_has_effect on HIGHEST/LOWEST_MAX_HEALTH_ALLY carrying the survivor's own token (PASS).
proofs.P6: cleanseprevent 1 round from The Quiet blocks Cleanse on the following turn only (PASS).
